title: Stock
description: What is in each location and of each material. Read-only: stock changes with entries and exits.

opening.title: Opening inventory
opening.description: Loads the stock of the inventory file (.xlsx) into the warehouse's temporary location. It is reviewed first without saving anything; then you confirm. A warehouse is loaded once.

control.label: Control total
control.matches: The sum ({{total}}) matches the control total ({{control}}).
control.mismatch: The sum ({{total}}) does not match the control total ({{control}}). It cannot be loaded.
control.none: The file carries no control total.

opening.missing: Materials of the file that do not exist: import the materials first.
opening.alreadyLoaded: This warehouse already has its opening inventory. Confirming loads nothing.
opening.done: {{count}} materials were loaded into the temporary location.
opening.nothing: Nothing was loaded: the warehouse already had its opening inventory.
